## Code when you need it, UI when you don't

Other tools limit you to either a visual building experience, or code. With n8n, you get the best of
both worlds.
* **Write JavaScript or Python** anywhere in your workflow. Imagine it, then build it.
* **See the inputs and outputs** right next to the settings of every step. No unnecessary clicks.
* **Test AI workflows with real data** to improve accuracy and catch errors before your customers
  do.

## Move fast. Break nothing.

Build with the short feedback loops that keep you in the flow.
* **Re-run single steps**, not your entire workflow
* **Replay or mock data** to not wait for external systems
* **Avoid endless debugging clicks** with the logs view
* **Evaluate AI natively** to optimize performance

app/api/chat/route.ts

import { streamText, tool } from "ai";
import { nexusAI } from "@/lib/ai/nexus";
import { z } from "zod";

const tools = {
  searchKnowledge: tool({
    description: "Search the knowledge base",
    parameters: z.object({
      query: z.string(),
      limit: z.number().optional().default(5),
    }),
    execute: async ({ query, limit }) => {
      const results = await searchKnowledgeBase(query, limit);
      return results.map(r => ({
        content: r.content,
        document: r.documentName,
        score: r.score,
      }));
    },
  }),
};

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { messages } = await req.json();
  const result = streamText({
    model: nexusAI("GLM-5.1"),
    system: systemPrompt,
    messages,
    tools,
    maxSteps: 5, // Multi-step tool calling
  });
  return result.toDataStreamResponse();
}

import { streamText, tool } from "ai";
import { nexusAI } from "@/lib/ai/nexus";
import { z } from "zod";

const tools = {
  searchKnowledge: tool({
    description: "Search the knowledge base",
    parameters: z.object({
      query: z.string(),
      limit: z.number().optional().default(5),
    }),
    execute: async ({ query, limit }) => {
      const results = await searchKnowledgeBase(query, limit);
      return results.map(r => ({
        content: r.content,
        document: r.documentName,
        score: r.score,
      }));
    },
  }),
};

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { messages } = await req.json();
  const result = streamText({
    model: nexusAI("GLM-5.1"),
    system: systemPrompt,
    messages,
    tools,
    maxSteps: 5, // Multi-step tool calling
  });
  return result.toDataStreamResponse();
}

OEM automation, built for service operations

# AutOEMate

Build custom diagnostic automations tailored to your needs, then let Smart Scan run them hands-free
— plug the vehicle in, walk away, and come back to clean scan data, reports, discovered work, and
more.

[Contact us →][8] [See the workflow][9]
**Custom Workflows** Build your own workflows tailored to your shop's exact needs — create them
once, run them in a single click.
**Smart Scan** Arm Smart Scan and a scan kicks off the moment a vehicle is connected — no clicks, no
waiting.
**Capture** Captures valuable scan data for reports and discovered work, stored safely on the local
PC.
**Report** Turns scan results into clear, shareable outputs for technicians and advisors alike.

The product

## A desktop automation console for real service-bay work.

AutOEMate turns repetitive OEM diagnostic steps into one-click, repeatable workflows — so every
vehicle gets consistent scans, cleaner documentation, and more discovered work, with less time spent
driving the tool.

[AutOEMate desktop app home screen with a ROB Check custom workflow armed to run, default scan types
(Health Check, DTC Scan, Data Snapshot), the Smart Scan toggle, and live voltage and DLC connection
status.] Choose any scan type and execute instantly — or simply arm Smart Scan, connect your
vehicle, and walk away while intelligent automation handles the rest. Recorded against the
diagnostic simulator — no real vehicle or customer data.
01

### Automated health-check path

Launch and login, connect to the vehicle, decode VIN, run the Health Check, record data, and print
the result.

02

### Custom automations built by you

Record and save automation sequences built around your needs and the exact data you want to capture
and document, then launch them in a single click.

03

### Evidence and teaching

Every run is saved locally with its scan data, reports, and notes — giving your team a reliable
record to revisit, share, and improve on.

Positioning

## Grow service-drive revenue and free your technicians to multitask.

Built first for GTS+ service operations, AutOEMate brings OEM workflow automation, faster
throughput, and cleaner documentation to any team that lives in factory diagnostic tools — from busy
dealership lanes to advanced independent shops.

### Service managers

Reduce diagnostic idle time, standardize scan documentation, and build a clearer ROI story around
completed scans and discovered work.

### Technicians

Spend less time clicking through the same OEM screens. Pause, resume, and take over manually when
the vehicle or workflow needs judgment.

### Advisors

Use scan results, before-and-after comparisons, and future advisor/customer report styles to explain
work with less translation friction.

Workflow story

## From plug-in to useful diagnostic record.
1. 1**Start**Technician launches a real GTS workflow from OEAutomate.
2. 2**Authenticate**Sign-in credentials are stored securely on the local PC, so each run starts
   without re-entering them.
3. 3**Connect**The app detects known vehicle connection states and offers manual VIN or retry
   recovery paths.
4. 4**Scan**Health Check is automated first, with Smart Scan voltage monitoring staged for
   technician-friendly triggers.
5. 5**Preserve**Logs, reports, state snapshots, and run artifacts support troubleshooting and future
   reporting.

Dealership value

## Estimate the monthly productivity upside.

This is an illustrative calculator for sales conversations. Replace the defaults with real pilot
numbers once one store runs actual repair orders through the workflow.

Training

## Separate operator training from product marketing.

### Technician quick start

Install, save credentials, run a Health Check, recover from VIN or connection issues, and stop
safely.

### Advisor report handoff

Read scan output, compare inspection and completion results, and explain findings with customer-safe
language.

### Admin and pilot setup

Tablet setup, GTS prerequisites, J2534/Mongoose checks, local data folder, support bundle, and
update process.

Choose a monthly plan, enter payment details through Stripe, install the signed Windows app, and
sign in with your checkout email. Your card is charged after seven days unless you cancel first.

## Deploy AI where the stakes are highest, with confidence

Regulated industries were built for control, and AI agents were built for autonomy. That tension is
why most enterprises stall before agents reach production.

##### The tension

In banking, insurance, healthcare, and government, every action must be attributable, defensible,
and reversible, so the work that would benefit most from AI is exactly the work compliance won't
allow near it.

##### The trap

Teams that try to close the gap end up with guardrails bolted after the fact, black-box agents no
one can audit, and pilots that never leave the lab.

##### Our approach

Flowable deploys agents where stakes are highest, bounded by your rules, governed centrally, fully
traceable. Built on BPMN, CMMN, and DMN, standards Flowable has run for 15+ years, what you build
stays inspectable, portable, and yours.

##### Our promise

Agents in production, exceptions handled, lower costs, and compliance that holds across every
action. The high-stakes work that once kept AI out is no longer a hurdle.

seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.

product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

### Simplify

### Local

National brand marketing is not enough. Local marketing reaches more consumers closest to the point

[Learn More][74]
[icn-marketing]

## Revenue Growth & Marketing ROI

What is marketing ROI?  It’s the return in known sales or tracked sales leads from your marketing
investment.  ROI in marketing is a hot topic, as budget pressure intensifies and digital platforms
can be traced directly to sales.  Brands selling through channels can increase revenue growth and
improve ROI on marketing spend with JGSullivan’s local marketing portal and integrated ad builder
system that ensures brand and legal compliance at the retail level.

## Cost Control & Operational Efficiency

Marketing cost control & operational efficiency are needs of every National and International brand.
We understand your marketplace is evolving daily. We understand your need to reduce costly, manual
operations and provide your channel partners with local marketing campaigns to boost their sales –
marketing your product online.

## Field Brand Compliance Control

You’ve invested in your brand. Protect it with JGSullivan’s brand compliance portal and integrated
ad builder that creates brand-friendly newspaper ads, Google landing pages, microsites, e-commerce
solutions, mobile sites and more for your local channel partners. Brand compliance and control at
retail is more complicated than ever in today’s evolving media world as retailers can now increase
their local visibility from an endless supply of oftentimes questionable digital material.

## Field Adoption & Ease of Use

User adoption is key to the success of any platform. A system seldom used isn’t protecting your
brand, and worse, it’s wasting your marketing resources. The adoption of technology to simplify a
business process will always be a challenge, but it’s one we’ve been perfecting for more than 17+
years.

## Channel Conflict

We understand that channel conflict is a challenge when your channel partners want to put your
competitors next to your trademark on their homepage, or when they want to link from your dealer or

Workflow Orchestration Platform

# Build with AI.
# Execute with Kinetic.

Kinetic is the workflow orchestration platform where AI builds your forms, workflows, and
integrations — and a governed, deterministic engine runs them reliably across the systems you
already have. Build in days. Execute at scale.

[ See How It Works ][4] [ Book a Demo ][5]

Connects with the systems you already use

[ServiceNow] ServiceNow
[Salesforce] Salesforce
[SAP] SAP
[Workday] Workday
[Oracle] Oracle
[Microsoft] Microsoft
[BMC] BMC
[Atlassian] Atlassian
[ View all pre-built integrations ][6]

The real problem

## The problem isn't your systems. It's what happens between them.

Work moves through email, spreadsheets, and manual handoffs — not because your tools are bad, but
because nothing connects them.

3 weeks

Average time to provision infrastructure at a federal agency — for a process that should take
minutes.

85 pages

The manual process one defense agency used to manage recruiting workflows across disconnected
systems.

5 days

To route a single approval through a mission-critical process — because each step lived in a
different system.

This is what Kinetic replaces. Not your systems — the gaps between them.

Already consolidating? Good.

## Consolidate the back end. Stabilize the front end.

Reducing the number of systems you own and giving people one reliable place to get work done are two
different jobs, on two different layers. Kinetic isn't another destination to consolidate into —
it's the orchestration layer that lets you consolidate everything else, while your people keep one
constant place to work.

Systems of record · back end

### Consolidate & standardize

Authoritative data and commodity processes. Keep them clean and close to out-of-the-box so they stay
cheap to maintain — and swappable.

Workflow orchestration · front end of work

### Stabilize & own

Your cross-system workflows and the interface people actually use. It stays constant while the
systems beneath it change.

You can't safely consolidate what you can't decouple.

How it works

## From idea to execution

Three steps to reliable, cross-system workflow orchestration.

1

### Define the workflow

Design workflows visually. AI can assist in generating structure and logic to accelerate
configuration.

2

### Structure the process

Kinetic turns workflows into governed, repeatable systems with rules, approvals, and conditional
logic.

3

### Execute across systems

Orchestrate actions across your systems of record. Every step is deterministic, auditable, and
consistent.

Build once. Run at scale.

AI + Workflows

## Use AI where it creates value. Let workflows handle the rest.

AI accelerates how workflows are created and adds intelligence as a step within them — classifying
requests, extracting data, recommending actions. But execution stays deterministic. Repeatable.
Auditable.

AI does what AI does best
* Classify incoming requests
* Extract data from documents
* Recommend next actions
* Summarize and prioritize

Workflows do the rest
* Route approvals deterministically
* Provision across systems
* Enforce compliance rules
* Full audit trail, every step

Cost

AI tokens are expensive. Workflows are cheap.

Auditability

AI decisions must be traceable. Workflows are by default.

Reliability

Repeatable processes need deterministic execution.

Bring your own AI models. Kinetic gives them the right job — and handles the rest.

From prototype to production

## AI can generate an app in minutes. Running it in production is the hard part.

AI is genuinely fast at generating forms, workflows, and integrations. What it doesn't give you is
everything below the waterline — the security, governance, reliability, and operations that turn a
generated app into something you can actually run in a regulated enterprise.

That's the layer Kinetic provides. Build with AI on top; execute on a governed, auditable,
deterministic engine underneath.
* Security, access control & SSO
* Compliance, governance & audit logging
* High availability, backup & disaster recovery
* Monitoring, observability & cost management

[Comparison: a vibe-coded app has nothing beneath the surface, while an app built with Kinetic has
security and governance, reliability and recovery, and operations beneath the waterline.] AI gets
you the tip. Kinetic is the rest of the iceberg.

How Kinetic works

## Modernize without replacing anything

Kinetic sits on top of your existing systems of record — ServiceNow, SAP, Workday, legacy mainframes
— and orchestrates work across them. You get a unified experience layer without migrating data,
retraining staff, or renegotiating contracts.

USDA

Deployed on top of existing infrastructure in **4 days** — no migration, no downtime. Provisioning
dropped from **3 weeks to 30 minutes**.

Auditable.

* Full audit trail, every step

Auditability

Reliability

Repeatable processes need deterministic execution.

Bring your own AI models. Kinetic gives them the right job — and handles the rest.
